answer_1.quote: Under this background, the text summarization community presents multilingual summarization (MLS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS) ... we propose PISCES, a pre-trained M2MS model that learns language modeling, cross‑lingual ability and summarization ability via three pre‑training stages
answer_1.outputs: Summaries generated in the target language

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE-1/2/L and BERTSCORE in our experiments. The ROUGE scores measure the lexical overlap ... while the BERTSCORE measures the semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: We conduct the human evaluation on 50 random samples ... Three graduate students are invited to assess the generated summaries from three aspects: informativeness (IF), conciseness (CC) and grammaticality (GM). The scoring adopts a 5‑point scale from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each summary on informativeness, conciseness, and grammaticality using a 5‑point Likert scale.
